financing.summary: Riverside is the homebuilding arm of Tim Fleet's Lackland Holdings, which buys and develops land in-house and sells finished lots to Riverside and to other builders, so the group already acts as its own land bank. Lackland's website says plainly that it is not interested in new financing sources and that it uses its own equity plus bank financing when necessary; it also holds income properties it says it never sells. Public-record listings point to Texas and regional banks (Simmons Bank, Vista Bank, Clayton Bank and Trust, American National Bank & Trust, Pinnacle, Vantage Bank Texas) lending to Riverside and to single-purpose Lackland land entities; no facility terms, lot counts or balance-sheet figures are public. This is a conventional for-sale builder (about 650 closings a year, DFW only) but a low-probability land-banking customer on its own stated terms; the realistic openings are selling it lots or a deal-by-deal partnership, which Lackland's site invites, and both run through Tim Fleet.
financing.land_strategy: Owns and self-develops. The affiliate Lackland Holdings acquires residentially zoned land, develops it (often into one-acre-plus homesites in exurban DFW counties) and sells lots to Riverside and to other builders; Riverside's in-house counsel described taking lots down from the development side through scheduled lot takedowns. No stated owned/optioned target and no third-party land banker. Lackland says it is 'always open' to buying more residential land or finished single-family lots.

lots.note: No lot counts are published by Riverside or Lackland Holdings. Scale indicators only: about 25 communities on the Riverside site (November 2026); 640+ to 649 closings in 2025; Lackland says the group has completed over 250 developments or acquisitions in six states.

land_banking.description: Tim Fleet's development company (formed 1991, same office as Riverside). It develops land and sells lots to multiple builders including what it calls 'our wholly owned Riverside Homebuilders', which makes it Riverside's captive lot supplier. Its site states it is not interested in new financing sources and funds itself with its own equity and bank financing when necessary.
land_banking.note: Riverside blog posts describe Lackland as a 'sister company' (2023) and as Riverside's 'real estate development partner' (2021); the parent/subsidiary wording is Lackland's own. Lackland publishes 817-731-7595 and webinfo@lacklandholdings.com for land sellers and transaction partners.

land_banking.counterparty: Lackland single-purpose land entities (Lackland Land Developer Ltd; Lackland Collin County Development LLC; Lackland Hillcrest North Development LLC; Fairview North Development LLC; FFILP Land Holdings LLC; Lackland Rio Ltd; Northstar Ranch LLC)
land_banking.description: Public-record listings show land held and financed in separate project entities at the Lackland address, with 2026 parcel acquisitions in Collin and Wise counties and 2026 bank loans to several of them. This is how the group carries land off Riverside's own books without an outside land banker.
